body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Sony unveiled its Bravia TV 'KDL-NX800' at CES 2010, which is equipped with Wi-Fi 802.11n capability and supports Full HD 1080p resolution with Edge LED backlight with Monolithic Design.
It also features Sony's new Monolithic Design, Bravia Internet Video and Widgets. It will be available by March.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
